payload.claim: Increasing the total number of periods to the maximum allowed (24 layers) will maximize the depth of the visible reflection stopband, pushing mean reflectance closer to unity.

predictions.controlled_conditions: Same thickness parameters, doubled layer count.
predictions.reason: Doubling the number of periods from 6 to 12 (24 layers) significantly increases the number of interfering interfaces, which theoretically drives the reflectance in the stopband closer to 100%, thus increasing the mean reflectance.

payload.rationale: Increasing the total number of periods to the maximum allowed (24 layers) will maximize the depth of the visible reflection stopband, pushing mean reflectance closer to unity.
